mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever wondered how the way we talk online is changing the language we use every day? Welcome to a journey where words, emojis, and memes shape how we connect, laugh, and even argue. Together, we’ll explore the incredible ways the internet has become a playground for language, where the lines between what we say and what we type are constantly blurring. As we dive into the ideas brought to life in Because Internet: Understanding the New Rules of Language by Gretchen McCulloch, you’ll start to see just how creative—and inventive—our digital conversations can be. Think about it: every time you send a meme, use an emoji, or drop a quick “lol,” you’re taking part in a massive experiment that’s reshaping language itself. Online spaces like forums, social media, and group chats are now living laboratories, where new forms of expression pop up every day. Suddenly, punctuation, capitalization, even a well-timed GIF, can say more than words ever could. And yet, all these changes aren’t just random—they’re shaped by the habits and creativity of people just like us. So, as we set off on this adventure, let’s discover what our digital words reveal about who we are, how we connect, and where language might be heading next. Get ready to see your everyday conversations in a whole new light.
